{{Tabs|History=No}} {{For|[[Missile APC]] or [[Gunner Elf]]}} {{UnitInfobox |title1 = Gunner APC |image-static = GunnerAPCDefault.png |image-dynamic = GunnerAPCDynamic.png |pseudoxd = true |source = [[Commander]] |type = Vehicle |spawnrate = [[File:VehicleSpawn.png|20px|Spawnrate]]60s (Ability Cooldown) |health = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]200 |damage_type = Single
Collision |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]7 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.2 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]30 |speed = 4 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Yes}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Yes}} (Collision only) |flying = {{Attr|Flying|Yes}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gunner APC''' ('''Armored Personnel Carrier''') is a unit spawned by the [[Commander]]'s ''Support Caravan'' ability. Two of them spawn with each ability use, one at the start and the other at the end of the caravan. The ability itself has a 60 second cooldown and costs {{Money|2,000}} to use. As with other units, the '''Gunner APC''' started from the path's exit and moved towards the entrance. It can detect hidden enemies. ==Appearance== The '''Gunner APC''' is a khaki-colored and typical in appearance to other APCs in real life. It has six lights on the front and multiple hatches.
